conviction_note: Small offsetting evidence. An easy Q3 2025 base (5.9% operating margin, -$6.2M other losses with FX) and the H1 2026 margin recovery point up. North America same-store weakness and a soft Singapore F&B quarter point down. The bar is unsourced, both rebuilt prior prints with good headlines were sold in HK (-4.85%, -5.26% intraday), and the scored ADS trades a few hundred shares a day. So p_up is 52 and the move is a wide 6 points. impact_sum (+0.10) and the scaled +0.24 agree in sign and are both near zero.
bar: Largely unsourced. Benzinga lists a Q3'26 EPS consensus of $0.01 with no revenue consensus (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/HDL/earnings-forecasts, snippet only, page 403). Seeking Alpha shows a ~$912M revenue consensus for an unstated period (https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/HDL/earnings/estimates, snippet only). If that is FY2026, H2 is ~$467M against H1 $444.7M (Q1 $225.9M + Q2 $218.8M), so Q3 is roughly $228-232M, +7-8% on Q3 2025's $214.0M. The company gives no numeric guidance; qualitatively, management expects 'operating leverage as the second half enters the peak season' and double-digit H2 openings (https://earningswhispers.com/transcript/HDL/Q22026). Q1 revenue beat ($225.9M vs $215.6M) and Q2 missed ($218.8M vs $222.8M), per Benzinga snippets. Because the bar has one source, every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: ADS short interest is about 1.1K shares with 1.6 days to cover, against ~732 shares average daily volume (settlement 2026-09-30, https://stockmarketwatch.com/stock/HDL/short-interest). MarketBeat had 3,739 shares and 7.1 days in mid-July 2026. These are trivial absolute numbers, so there is no squeeze mechanism. No options market, so no skew (baseline: no_options_market). The ADS is very thin: baseline 20d average volume 75 and stockanalysis daily volume 54-6,108 shares. Price discovery happens in HK 9658 (200k-700k shares/day). HK 9658 has held HK$7.84-8.47 since mid-October and closed HK$7.96 on 2026-11-24, near its 52-week low (ADS -46% from its high). Sell-side targets are ~US$17.38 average across 6 analysts (Longbridge, undated).

findings.finding: The Q3 2025 base was a weak margin quarter (operating income $12.6M, -15.4% YoY, margin 5.9% vs 7.5%), and 2026 has run well above its 2025 comps: Q1 operating income +70.7% to $14.0M, Q2 +118.9% to $8.1M (margin 3.7% vs 1.9%) with staff costs down to 34.3% of revenue from 35.3%. Management flagged H2 peak-season operating leverage, so a YoY rise in Q3 operating income (roughly $14-18M at 6-8% margin) is the likely print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Rebuilt from confirmed releases (the baseline history is untrustworthy). Q3 2024: a profit turnaround still saw HK 9658 fall 4.85% (https://www.itiger.com/news/2486041874). Q1 2025: a profit turnaround with revenue +5.4% saw 9658 fall as much as 5.26% intraday (https://www.itiger.com/news/1185775744). Good operating headlines have been sold.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock is at its 52-week low and flat for six weeks in HK, so it is not pricing a margin recovery. If the market expected a strong YoY operating jump, 9658 would not have drifted from HK$8.74 (Oct 13) to HK$7.96 into the print. Partly priced: management said it, and SPDB International expects 2026 margins back near 2024 levels.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 release, operating income +118.9% (https://finviz.com/news/385606/super-hi-reports-unaudited-financial-results-for-the-second-quarter-of-2026). Management's 'operating leverage as the second half enters the peak season' (https://earningswhispers.com/transcript/HDL/Q22026). SPDBI upgrade, May 2026, management expecting FY turnover up (https://stock.10jqka.com.cn/20260526/c676979704.shtml). All are company statements or derived from them.

findings.finding: Headline net profit faces an easy FX comparison. Q3 2025 profit was only $3.6M (-90% YoY) because other losses were -$6.2M after a $31.7M YoY swing in FX. Super Hi does not hedge and gains when the USD weakens; the broad dollar was 'little changed' over Q3 2026 despite a ~1.5-2% September rally. Reported profit and the Chinese-wire headline ('净利润同比增长') could therefore show a multiple of last year's $3.6M even on flat operations.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: a net loss of $1.9M on a $4.34M FX loss against an operating income doubling; the reaction is not established. Q3 2025: the -90% headline profit (FX-driven) is in 'already_in_the_wire', and its reaction is not sourced. Management calls FX 'non-operating, non-cash'.
findings.why_not_priced: Sell-side models rarely forecast an unhedged FX line, and the Benzinga Q3 EPS consensus of $0.01 sits near last year's per-share level, which suggests no FX normalisation is modelled. It is below operating income with no path to the guide, so it is sized as a fraction.
findings.independence: The NY Fed Q3 2026 FX report says the broad dollar was little changed on net (https://www.newyorkfed.org/medialibrary/media/newsevents/news/markets/2026/q3-2026-fx-quarterly-report.pdf; the text was unreadable, the characterisation is from the search snippet). Counterweight: the yen was weak (MOF intervention links in August 2026) and the rupiah sank in July; the exposure mix is unknown, so FX could still be a loss.

findings.finding: North America is deteriorating at company level. Q2 2026 NA same-store sales were $34.7M vs $37.9M (-8.5%) and same-store turnover 3.6 vs 4.0. Management said 'the higher average check has not fully offset the impact of the lower turnover' and is reviewing relocations. The Q3 2025 NA base is same-store turnover 3.9 and SSS +3.2%, so a third straight negative NA comp is likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 carried the NA decline; that print's reaction is not sourced. Since then HDL has fallen from ~$12 (Sep 10) to $9.81.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is public and part of the drawdown. What is not priced is whether it widened in Q3 against a tougher NA base (3.9 turns). Net of the rest: NA is ~17% of Haidilao restaurant revenue (~$14M per quarter in restaurant revenue per the call). East Asia (same-store turnover 5.2 vs 4.8 in Q2; Korea H1 sales +28.4%) can offset it, so the size is net and small.
findings.independence: Q2 call transcript (https://earningswhispers.com/transcript/HDL/Q22026). Same company document family, so it counts as one item.

findings.finding: Southeast Asia's largest single market looked soft in Q3. Singapore's F&B services sales were -1.9% YoY in July and -1.6/-1.8% in August, then +1.0% in September with restaurants +2.6% (SingStat). Southeast Asia is 73 of 129 stores and ~half of same-store sales. It is a weak proxy against an easy SE Asia base (Q3 2025 SE Asia SSS -1.4%, same-store turnover 3.8 flat).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not established for the SE Asia line.
findings.source_date: 2026-11 (September 2026 release; page 403, figures from search snippet)
findings.why_not_priced: It is a macro series nobody maps to Super Hi. It is a proxy for one country of several (Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia and the Philippines are unread). The company's own Q2 SE Asia same-store turnover rose to 3.8 from 3.7, which a broader company number weighs against, hence small.
findings.independence: Proxy only. July and August are from the same SingStat series (https://www.singstat.gov.sg/news/monthly-retail-sales-index-and-food-beverage-services-index-jul2026). No company confirmation.

findings.finding: Management targets 'double-digit new store openings' in H2 2026 across NA, East Asia and SE Asia, but opened only 2 in Q2 (127 to 129 stores). The Q3 count will show whether the target is on track. Openings bring pre-opening costs into Q3/Q4 margins, while a shortfall dents the growth narrative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No sourced reaction to a store-count surprise.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q3 store count is unknown, and no openings were found in news searches for Q3. Management tied openings to 'July and August construction schedules' and 'several' openings, so Q3 may show few and push the double-digit target into Q4. The sign is ambiguous, so the size is small.
findings.independence: Quartr summary also states 'Double-digit new store openings targeted for H2 2026' (https://quartr.com/events/super-hi-international-holding-ltd-9658-q2-2026_FMaRPxO4). It is the same call, so one item.

findings.finding: Venue mechanics: the scored instrument is the HDL ADS (1 ADS = 10 shares), which trades tens to a few thousand shares a day. The results land at ~20:00 HK time after the HK close, so on 2026-11-25 the ADS is the only venue pricing the news. ADS closed $9.81 on Nov 23 against an HK-parity of ~$10.09 (HK$7.85). HK closed HK$7.96 (~$10.23 parity) on Nov 24, and the ADS was $10.38 at 12:33 ET on 54 shares.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: ADS daily closes swing 3-6% on a few hundred shares without news (e.g. Oct 22 $9.74, Oct 23 $10.36), per stockanalysis history.
findings.why_not_priced: This is not a directional finding. It tells judges the realised ADS move will carry ±2-4 points of venue noise and parity drift on top of the fundamental reaction, so abs_move is set wide.
findings.independence: HK 9658 closes from https://stockanalysis.com/quote/hkg/9658/history/ (a different instrument, same data vendor).

findings.finding: Drawdown and sentiment: HK 9658 has been range-bound at HK$7.84-8.47 since mid-October and sits near its 52-week low. The ADS is -46.45% from its 52-week high and -6.48% over 20 days, after a ~30% one-day surge in June 2026 that has fully reversed. Average sell-side targets are ~$17.38. No cause for the drawdown beyond Q2's NA weakness and FX loss was found.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: June 9, 2026: 9658 surged nearly 30% intraday on turnover and margin recovery (https://finance.sina.com.cn/stock/hkstock/marketalerts/2026-06-09/doc-iniauquz1961964.shtml, headline only).
findings.why_not_priced: An unexplained drawdown is worth 0 by rule. It is filed so the judges see that expectations are low and that a merely inline print meets a depressed base.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-26 Super Hi renewed its Yihai master purchase agreement (hot-pot base and condiments) with annual caps of $29.0M (2027), $35.2M (2028) and $41.4M (2029), ~+20% a year, signalling planned volume growth. EGM on 2026-12-17.
findings.why_not_priced: Caps are ceilings, not forecasts. It is public since Oct 26 and moved nothing (HK went HK$8.08 to 7.99 Oct 26-27). Barely bears on Q3; any read-through is about the outlook commentary on the call.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-02 Super Hi announced changes to its joint company secretaries, authorised representatives and financial controller (with a Listing Rule 3.28/8.17 waiver), a finance-function change shortly before the Q3 close.
findings.why_not_priced: Probably routine (Haidilao-group staff rotation). The reason was not read, so it is sized at zero.

findings.finding: East Asia momentum continues: Korea (12 company stores) posted H1 2026 sales of ~72bn won, +28.4%, and is adding the single-diner 'Haifive' format. East Asia same-store turnover was 5.2 vs 4.8 in Q2. The Q3 2025 East Asia base is tough, though (SSS +18.1%, turnover 5.1 vs 4.3).
findings.why_not_priced: The Korea H1 figure is already in reported H1 numbers. Q3 East Asia faces a tough comp, so this is small and mostly offsets the NA and SE Asia negatives.
findings.independence: Q2 release East Asia same-store turnover (https://finviz.com/news/385606/super-hi-reports-unaudited-financial-results-for-the-second-quarter-of-2026).

outside_window.finding: EGM on 2026-12-17 to approve the renewed Yihai purchase agreement (connected transaction, controlling-shareholder related).

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with (no options market). The near-zero positive lean sits against a negative 5d/20d run-up and a stock at its 52-week low, which argues for low expectations rather than against the findings; p_up is held near 50 because this name has sold good-headline prints before.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (bar unsourced: one estimate source, no Q3 revenue consensus): capped every finding small; operating-leverage finding 0.8 -> 0.5, also moved toward 0 because management already said it (inside the guided direction).

Lesson 5 (proxy vs company number): Singapore F&B proxy -0.3 -> -0.2.
Lesson 9 (segment net of rest): North America finding -0.5 -> -0.4, net of East Asia strength.
Lesson 1 and the rebuilt reaction history (two good-headline prints sold in HK): p_up 53 -> 52.
